terms.meaning: Short for code generation, the step that writes source files automatically.
A compiler pass that looks for type mistakes without running the program.

used_by: Developers who run the codegen command.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Codegen command
sections.what: Runs the generator, then the library type check.
sections.why: Keeps the generated code and the type information in step.
sections.watch_out: Because generation runs first, a broken description can leave broken generated files even when the type check later fails.

summary: The package file for the API description folder. It has one command that regenerates the client and validation code, then type-checks the libraries.
purpose: Lets a developer regenerate the code from the API description.
why: Likely reason: generation is kept as a separate step from running the app. The code does not state this.
how: Declares a private package with a codegen command. That command runs the generator and then the library type check, and it lists the generator as a development dependency.
inputs: The orval config and the openapi.yaml file.
outputs: Regenerated code files and a type-check result.
risks: The generator runs before the type check, so a broken description can leave broken files behind. The version range allows minor updates.
debug: If codegen fails, run orval alone to see its error. If type errors follow, inspect the generated files.
